overview.description: The Simplify Barrier Income ETF (SBAR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund seeks to provide monthly income with a stated downside risk barrier of 30% over a one-year period. The actively managed fund holds US government securities while employing a put option spread writing strategy on a major US equity ETF SBAR was launched on Apr 14, 2025 and is issued by Simplify.
